`single_activity.fit` is a 200-byte synthetic activity generated by the
stdlib-only `tests/fit_fixture.py` helper (the byte count can be checked locally).
It contains one session, three records, one lap and two timer events; duplicate
timestamps, zero power and missing values are deliberate. It contains no
coordinates, athlete/device identifiers, or personal source data.

Regenerate from the repository root:

```bash
PYTHONPATH=tests python3 -c 'from pathlib import Path; from fit_fixture import make_fit; Path("tests/fixtures/single_activity.fit").write_bytes(make_fit())'
```
